evidence: Modifies net_processing.cpp and P2P functional tests to drop malformed blocks and transactions on deserialization error rather than disconnecting peers.
rationale: Mitigates P2P memory and CPU exhaustion by detecting malformed network messages early during deserialization. An attacker can currently force a node to deserialize up to 400,000 zero-input/zero-output transactions or 16M block weight from a 4 MB message before validation rejects it, which this change prevents.
